title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 501 Mercer Street Southwest in Wilson, North Carolina, as the "Milton F. Fitch, Sr. Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 501 Mercer Street Southwest in Wilson, North Carolina, as the Milton F. Fitch, Sr. Post Office Building.

summary.headline: Congress named a Wilson, North Carolina Postal Service building after Milton F. Fitch, Sr.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 501 Mercer Street Southwest in Wilson, North Carolina, as the Milton F. Fitch, Sr. Post Office Building. It is an honorary naming and does not change how the post office operates. The summary does not describe any other changes.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 2, 2025, and the name applies from that date.
